verdict.rationale: Orama's feature list includes Pinning Rules (Merchandising), which provide manual business-driven result positioning. Fields Boosting and BM25 let developers tune relevance, but both still operate on textual matching. Nothing in the evidence shows ranking by numeric business signals such as popularity, recency or margin. Missing for 10: documented custom ranking or scoring functions on business attributes (popularity, recency, margin), in-depth docs on pinning and boosting configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
